title: Machine learning-accelerated discovery of multi-cation entropy-stabilized NASICON solid electrolytes with 10 000 hours of stable Na plating/stripping for all-solid-state sodium batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,860-869
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06594A, Paper
Open Access

Daxian Zuo, Jiaming Tian, Yu Sun, Xin Yu, Bo Peng, Tao Yu, Chengrong Xu, Xiangqun Xu, Yigang Wang, Yiwen Liu, Tianze Shi, Yinhui Feng, Jie Yang, Haoshen Zhou, Shaohua Guo
Machine learning (ML)-guided entropy engineering approach discovers a medium-entropy NASICON solid electrolyte (Na3.5Zr1.0Ti0.5Lu0.5Si2PO12) with 1.3 mS cm−1 conductivity, 10 000 hours of Na cycling, and superior battery performance.
